channel.title: Dr Shyam N Gupta - Writing
channel.description: Editorials and notes on fertility medicine from Dr Shyam N Gupta, Fertility & IVF Specialist, Bengaluru.

item.title: Fertility Medicine in 2030: from IVF clinic to intelligent reproductive health systems
item.description: Seven shifts that will define the next decade of reproductive medicine — AI-assisted embryology, male fertility moving to centre stage, evidence-based personalisation, fertility preservation, honest outcome reporting, and why trust will remain the strongest medicine.

item.title: When hope refused to give up
item.description: A couple, eleven years of marriage, six clinics and two failed IVF cycles — and what their daughter taught me about the part of fertility medicine that never appears in a protocol.

item.title: Advanced fertility care in Bengaluru: services and approach
item.description: What each treatment actually involves — natural conception support, infertility workup, IUI, IVF and ICSI, and reproductive immunogenetics for couples with repeated miscarriage or failed cycles.
